abstract: Providing nutritious meals in institutional settings with financial constraints, such as military dining facilities, is challenging. The US Department of War (DoW) and US Department of Agriculture (USDA) collaborated to modernize the Basic Daily Food Allowance (BDFA) using an optimization model that incorporates service members' consumption patterns and nutritional standards. The model estimated optimal diets for four demographic groups, producing costs similar to the 2019 BDFA but with greater food variety. This first application of the USDA Food Plan to military purchase data demonstrates a flexible approach for improving cost estimates in military and other institutional food programs.
abstract_zh: 在资金受限的机构环境（如军队餐饮设施）中提供营养餐食颇具挑战。美国战争部与美国农业部合作，通过引入优化模型对基本每日食品津贴进行现代化改革，该模型整合了军人的消费模式与营养标准。模型为四个不同人口群体估算出最优膳食方案，其成本与2019年基本每日食品津贴相当，但食物种类更为丰富。此次将美国农业部食品计划首次应用于军购数据，展示了提升军队及其他机构食品项目成本估算灵活性的可行路径。
title: The Cost of a Nutritious Diet in Cafeterias: Evidence From US Military Dining Facilities
title_zh: 食堂营养膳食的成本：来自美国军队餐饮设施的证据

title_zh: 能源消费与劳动生产率在理解气候变化对国际贸易影响中的作用探究

abstract: Based on panel data of China's urban trade exports from 2006 to 2023, this study employs the National Innovative City Pilot (NICP) policy as a quasi-natural experiment and adopts a Time-varying Difference-in-differences approach to investigate the impact of innovation policies on urban export sophistication. The findings reveal that the NICP policy significantly enhances urban export sophistication, validating the positive efficacy of innovation policies in China's export sector. Mechanism analysis indicates that the policy promotes urban export sophistication by optimising urban infrastructure, stimulating technological innovation and advancing industrial structure upgrading. Furthermore, the empowering effect of this policy is more pronounced in late-developing cities, especially in the less-developed western regions, small and medium-sized cities and cities with relatively scarce resource endowments. This study also explores the synergistic effects between the Low-Carbon City Policy and the NICP policy, as well as between the Broadband China Policy and the NICP policy, finding that these policy synergies further enhance urban export sophistication. The research enriches the literature on urban export sophistication and provides valuable insights for China and other countries in refining policy design and implementation, as well as urban planning and development to boost export sophistication and foster foreign trade growth.
abstract_zh: 本研究基于2006至2023年中国城市贸易出口的面板数据，以创新型城市试点政策作为准自然实验，采用时变双重差分法探讨了创新政策对城市出口复杂度的影响。研究发现，创新型城市试点政策显著提升了城市出口复杂度，验证了创新政策在中国出口领域的积极效能。机制分析表明，该政策通过优化城市基础设施、激发技术创新及推动产业结构升级，进而促进城市出口复杂度的提升。此外，该政策的赋能效应在欠发达城市中更为显著，尤其是在发展较落后的西部地区、中小城市及资源禀赋相对匮乏的城市中表现突出。本研究还探讨了低碳城市政策与创新型城市试点政策之间，以及宽带中国政策与创新型城市试点政策之间的协同效应，发现这些政策协同进一步增强了城市出口复杂度。本研究丰富了关于城市出口复杂度的文献，并为中国及其他国家在完善政策设计与实施、以及城市发展规划以提升出口复杂度和促进外贸增长方面提供了有价值的参考。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Can Innovation Policies Enhance Export Sophistication? Evidence From China
title_zh: 创新政策能否提升出口复杂度？来自中国的证据

abstract: We study income tax competition in a structure of two adjacent two‐tier (federal‐regional) fiscal federations, where both upper‐tier and lower‐tier authorities tax income in the presence of income shifting within and between the federations. We show that when the federations are symmetric, horizontal competition leads to income‐shifting flows from rich regions (setting higher income tax rates) to poor regions (setting lower tax rates), both within and between federations. Moreover, income‐shifting facilities intensify tax competition, potentially increasing income redistribution from wealthier to poorer regions. However, in the case of asymmetric federations, the relationship between regional income tax rate and tax base and the resulting direction of inter‐regional income‐shifting flows are ambiguous due to the operation of vertical and diagonal fiscal externalities.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个由两个相邻的两级（联邦-地区）财政联邦制构成的收入税收竞争结构，其中，在存在联邦内部及联邦之间收入转移的情况下，上级和下级政府均对收入征税。研究表明，当联邦对称时，横向竞争会导致收入从富裕地区（设定较高所得税率）向贫困地区（设定较低税率）转移，这种转移既发生在联邦内部，也发生在联邦之间。此外，收入转移机制加剧了税收竞争，可能增加从富裕地区向贫困地区的收入再分配。然而，在非对称联邦的情况下，由于纵向和对角财政外部性的作用，地区所得税率与税基之间的关系以及由此产生的地区间收入转移方向具有不确定性。
title: Income distribution, taxation and shifting in a federal fiscal structure
title_zh: 联邦财政结构中的收入分配、税收与转移

abstract: The external validity of regression discontinuity designs is crucial for informing policy but is rarely examined in applied work. To advance empirical practice, we propose a joint inference procedure for the treatment effect and its local external validity, captured by the treatment effect derivative (TED), within a robust bias correction framework. We further introduce a locally linear treatment effects assumption, which extends the scope of the TED and enables identification and the construction of a uniform confidence band for extrapolated effects. These methods apply to most empirical studies. Empirical illustrations demonstrate their practical usefulness.
abstract_zh: 断点回归设计的外部有效性对于政策制定至关重要，但在应用研究中却鲜少被检验。为推进实证实践，我们提出了一种在稳健偏差校正框架内，对处理效应及其局部外部有效性（由处理效应导数TED衡量）进行联合推断的方法。我们进一步引入局部线性处理效应假设，该假设扩展了TED的适用范围，并能够识别外推效应并构建其一致置信带。这些方法适用于大多数实证研究。实证案例展示了其实际应用价值。
title: Joint Inference for the Regression Discontinuity Effect and Its External Validity
title_zh: 断点回归效应及其外部有效性的联合推断

abstract: This paper examines the effects of Environmental Policies—measured by the OECD Environmental Policy Stringency Index (EPS)—on employment in 349 regions across 26 countries from 1990 to 2020. We find that more stringent EPS have short‐term negative effects on regional employment, which disappear in the medium term. However, the magnitude of these effects is economically modest: a one standard deviation increase in EPS reduces employment by about 0.14% at its peak, corresponding to roughly 8% of typical annual regional employment fluctuations. The impact varies depending on the type of policy implemented, with market‐based instruments having a greater and more persistent effect. Importantly, while average effects are limited, employment costs are highly concentrated in specific regions—particularly those with higher emissions, larger industrial sectors and lower human capital. Regions in countries with stronger active labour market policies experience less short‐term negative effects, while lower employment protection leads to reallocation and job creation in the medium term.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1990年至2020年间，以OECD环境政策严格度指数（EPS）衡量的环境政策对26个国家349个地区就业的影响。我们发现，更严格的EPS对地区就业具有短期负面影响，但该影响在中期内消失。然而，这些影响的程度在经济意义上较为温和：EPS每提高一个标准差，就业在峰值时约下降0.14%，大致相当于典型地区年度就业波动的8%。影响因所实施政策类型而异，基于市场的工具具有更大且更持久的效果。重要的是，尽管平均效应有限，就业成本高度集中于特定地区——尤其是那些排放更高、工业部门更大和人力资本更低的地区。积极劳动力市场政策更强的国家中的地区，其短期负面影响较小，而较低的就业保护则在中期导致劳动力重新配置和就业创造。
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: The Heterogeneous Regional Employment Effects of Environmental Policies
title_zh: 环境政策的异质性区域就业效应

abstract: Abstract Since 2000, housing markets across Canada have experienced growth rates in prices that far exceed corresponding rates of household income growth. However, rents have grown at similar rates to household incomes. In the 2015–24 period, immigration has been a central booster of housing demand and population growth, compensating for declining birth rates. Annual per capita housing unit new construction rates have grown slightly, to about 0.0075 across all types of markets for 1991–2024, even as Canada's population boomed in 2023–24, with the composition shifting markedly from single‐family homes to multifamily structures. Purpose‐built rental construction has recently risen from very low levels. To understand these patterns, we consider local regulatory environments and infrastructure provision, rental housing supports, sources of housing demand growth, and Canada's macroprudential regulatory institutions and environment.
abstract_zh: 摘要 自2000年以来，加拿大各地住房市场的价格增长率远超家庭收入增长率。然而，租金增长与家庭收入增长速率相近。在2015年至2024年期间，移民成为住房需求和人口增长的主要推动力，弥补了出生率下降的影响。尽管加拿大在2023年至2024年间人口激增，但1991年至2024年间，各类市场的年人均新建住房单元率略有上升，约为0.0075，且住房结构从独户住宅显著转向多户住宅。专为出租而建的住房建设近期从极低水平开始回升。为理解这些现象，我们考察了地方监管环境与基础设施供给、租赁住房支持、住房需求增长来源，以及加拿大的宏观审慎监管制度与环境。
title: Viewpoint: Housing supply and housing affordability in Canada
title_zh: 观点：加拿大住房供给与住房可负担性

abstract: This study explores the effect of increases in the minimum wage on the probability of receiving employer‐sponsored supplementary prescription drug insurance through the workplace in Canada: Do Canadian employers respond to higher minimum wage by cutting insurance coverage? We use self‐reports on supplementary health insurance through the workplace from seven waves (2013 to 2019) of the Canadian Community Health Survey. We also use the fact that the minimum wage is a provincial jurisdiction in Canada to study the effects of the level of and changes in the minimum wage across provinces and over time in a difference‐in‐differences and triple difference framework. We find that yearly changes between 20 and 30 cents in the value of the minimum wage have a persistent effect and about three percent of Canadians lose their prescription drug insurance (from an initial coverage rate of 47.4%) in such cases, the effect being concentrated on women, immigrants, non‐Whites and younger adults. However, changes smaller than 20 cents, by far the most frequent in Canada, do not have any discernible effect on health insurance coverage.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了加拿大最低工资上涨对员工通过工作场所获得雇主资助的补充处方药保险概率的影响：加拿大雇主是否会通过削减保险覆盖来应对更高的最低工资？我们利用加拿大社区健康调查七个波次（2013年至2019年）中关于工作场所补充健康保险的自我报告数据。同时，鉴于最低工资在加拿大属于省级管辖范围，我们利用这一事实，在双重差分和三重差分框架下，研究各省份间及时间上最低工资水平及其变动的影响。我们发现，最低工资每年变动20至30加分时，会产生持续性影响，在此情况下，约有3%的加拿大人失去其处方药保险（初始覆盖率为47.4%），且这一影响主要集中在女性、移民、非白人和年轻成年人群体中。然而，低于20加分的变动——这在加拿大最为常见——对健康保险覆盖没有明显影响。
title: Minimum wage and employer‐sponsored supplementary health insurance: Evidence from Canada
title_zh: 最低工资与雇主资助的补充健康保险：来自加拿大的证据

abstract: Abstract Declining business dynamism has been observed across many advanced economies; however, its consequences have been less well studied. In this paper, we propose that declining business dynamism has led to a decrease in the financial constraints faced by firms. We use well established methods to identify financial constraints and then develop a new approach to measure the fraction of financially constrained firms. We find that the fraction has fallen over time and this is driven by rising firm age. Had business dynamism not declined, firms would be younger and more financially constrained.
abstract_zh: 许多发达经济体均观察到商业活力下降的现象，但其后果研究尚不充分。本文提出，商业活力下降导致企业面临的融资约束减少。我们采用成熟方法识别融资约束，并开发新途径衡量受融资约束企业所占比例。研究发现，该比例随时间下降，且此趋势由企业年龄增长驱动。若商业活力未下降，企业将更年轻且面临更严峻的融资约束。
title: Business dynamism and financial constraints
title_zh: 商业活力与金融约束

abstract: Abstract Understanding the drivers of structural change has long been a central objective in development economics. While quantitative models that integrate multiple mechanisms into a unified framework offer valuable insights into their relative importance, this paper offers an alternative empirical perspective by highlighting and comparing the distinct impacts that different mechanisms have on other dimensions of labour market outcomes. Specifically, it examines two key forces behind labour reallocation out of agriculture: international trade and reductions in intersectoral allocation frictions. The paper shows, both theoretically and empirically, that these forces have opposite effects on unemployment. It further emphasizes that the reallocation of market shares toward more productive firms is a crucial mechanism behind the impact of trade.
abstract_zh: 摘要 理解结构变迁的驱动因素一直是发展经济学的核心目标。尽管将多种机制整合到统一框架中的定量模型为其相对重要性提供了宝贵见解，但本文提供了一种替代性的实证视角，通过强调并比较不同机制对劳动力市场其他维度结果的独特影响。具体而言，本文考察了劳动力从农业部门转移的两大关键力量：国际贸易和部门间配置摩擦的减少。本文在理论和实证层面均表明，这两种力量对失业具有相反的影响。此外，本文强调，市场份额向更具生产率的企业重新配置是贸易影响背后的关键机制。
title: Employment allocations and unemployment: The role of international trade and migration frictions
title_zh: 就业配置与失业：国际贸易与移民摩擦的作用

abstract: This paper examines how the government's ability to commit, or not, to a specific emission tax level impacts environmental innovation and social welfare in fixed‐numbers and free‐entry oligopolies. We show that when the market is relatively concentrated, emission taxes are lower, while environmental innovation, profits and welfare are higher, under a time‐consistent policy than under a precommitment policy. Conversely, when the market concentration is relatively low, the rankings reverse. Furthermore, considering a free‐entry oligopoly, we show that there are still conditions under which the time‐consistent policy fosters higher environmental innovation and social welfare than a precommitment policy, even though the number of firms entering the market are higher under a time‐consistent emission tax. Therefore, contrary to prevailing beliefs, we show that the government's commitment to a policy may result in higher emissions and lower social welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了政府在固定数量与自由进入寡头市场中，对特定排放税水平承诺或不承诺的能力如何影响环境创新与社会福利。我们证明，在市场相对集中时，时间一致性政策下的排放税较低，而环境创新、利润和福利则高于预先承诺政策。相反，当市场集中度相对较低时，上述排序发生逆转。此外，考虑自由进入的寡头市场，我们表明，即使时间一致性排放税下进入市场的企业数量更多，仍存在条件使得时间一致性政策比预先承诺政策促进更高的环境创新和社会福利。因此，与普遍认知相反，我们证明政府对政策的承诺可能导致更高的排放和更低的社会福利。
title: Welfare‐enhancing, time‐consistent environmental policies in fixed‐numbers and free‐entry oligopolies
title_zh: 固定数量与自由进入寡头市场中福利增进且时间一致的环境政策

abstract: Using a perfectly competitive, general equilibrium model of international trade, specific import tariffs, specific export taxes and ad valorem trade taxes are compared in a trade war. A trade war is modelled as a Nash equilibrium in trade policies, where each country can choose to use ad valorem trade taxes (import tariffs or export taxes, which are equivalent), specific import tariffs or specific export taxes. In the two‐country case, where there is a negative terms of trade externality a specific export tax dominates a specific import tariff or ad valorem trade taxes. Hence, the Lerner symmetry theorem does not hold for specific trade taxes in a trade war. This result continues to hold when the model is extended to the case of many countries assuming that there is a negative terms of trade externality. In a trade‐policy game where two countries export the same good so that there is a positive terms of trade externality in the trade‐policy game between these two countries, the results are reversed, with a specific import tariff dominating a specific export tax or ad valorem trade taxes. Hence, the Lerner symmetry theorem again does not hold for specific trade taxes.
abstract_zh: 利用一个完全竞争、一般均衡的国际贸易模型，在贸易战中比较了特定进口关税、特定出口税和从价贸易税。贸易战被建模为贸易政策中的纳什均衡，其中每个国家可以选择使用从价贸易税（进口关税或出口税，两者等价）、特定进口关税或特定出口税。在两国情形下，存在负的贸易条件外部性时，特定出口税优于特定进口关税或从价贸易税。因此，勒纳对称定理在贸易战中对特定贸易税不成立。当模型扩展到多国情形，并假设存在负的贸易条件外部性时，这一结果依然成立。在两国出口相同商品从而在这两个国家间的贸易政策博弈中存在正的贸易条件外部性的情况下，结果则相反，特定进口关税优于特定出口税或从价贸易税。因此，勒纳对称定理再次对特定贸易税不成立。
title: The non‐equivalence of import tariffs and export taxes in trade wars: Ad valorem versus specific trade taxes
title_zh: 贸易战中进口关税与出口税的非等价性：从价税与从量税的比较

abstract: Abstract Traditional foods (often referred to as “country foods”) play a critical role in Indigenous culture, nutrition, food sovereignty and food security. Policies that prioritize store‐bought food are often viewed as undermining these foods. We provide evidence that two recent policy reforms that subsidize store‐bought food in the Northwest Territories do not appear to negatively impact traditional foods. Our analysis uses community surveys conducted in the Northwest Territories that measure the importance of consumption and production of traditional country food along several margins. Using a difference‐in‐differences methodology, we show that two transitions associated with the Nutrition North Canada subsidy program—the transition from Food Mail to Nutrition North from 2011 to 2012 and the expansion of subsidy eligibility to new communities in 2016—had a zero or positive impact on these outcomes. We use price and quantity data from multiple sources to provide evidence on mechanisms and find support for an interpretation based on country foods having a high income elasticity and low substitutability with store‐bought meat and other foods.
abstract_zh: 摘要 传统食物（常被称为“乡村食物”）在土著文化、营养、食物主权和食物安全中扮演着关键角色。优先考虑商店购买食品的政策常被视为削弱这些传统食物。我们提供的证据表明，西北地区近期两项补贴商店购买食品的政策改革似乎并未对传统食物产生负面影响。我们的分析利用在西北地区进行的社区调查，这些调查从多个维度衡量了传统乡村食物消费和生产的重要性。采用双重差分方法，我们显示与“营养北方加拿大”补贴计划相关的两次转变——2011年至2012年从“食品邮件”向“营养北方”的过渡，以及2016年补贴资格扩展至新社区——对这些结果产生了零或正面的影响。我们利用多来源的价格和数量数据来提供机制证据，并支持一种基于乡村食物具有高收入弹性且与商店购买的肉类及其他食品替代性低的解释。
title: Traditional Indigenous foodways and retail subsidies: Evidence from the Northwest Territories Community Survey and Nutrition North Canada
title_zh: 传统原住民饮食方式与零售补贴：来自西北地区社区调查与加拿大北部营养计划的证据

abstract: This paper examines the effects of monetary policy in a small open economy participating in the global value chains by constructing a model with firm heterogeneity and production fragmentation. Liquidity constraints and terms‐of‐trade externality distort the sorting of firms into different operations. Under a flexible exchange‐rate regime, changes in domestic interest rate can affect the distribution of firms across different trade modes, the economy's processing and ordinary trade flows, and economic welfare. The presence of processing trade is shown to alter the monetary policy trade‐off. When the domestic interest rate is the only policy instrument available, the second‐best optimal interest rate will be zero (positive) in the case with a sufficiently low (high) output elasticity of imported input in the production of final‐good export. The ability of the Friedman rule to address the distortions from the terms‐of‐trade externality hinges on the relatively higher labour intensity in processing than in ordinary production.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个包含企业异质性与生产碎片化的模型，考察了参与全球价值链的小型开放经济体中的货币政策效应。流动性约束与贸易条件外部性扭曲了企业进入不同运营模式的选择。在灵活汇率制度下，国内利率变动能够影响企业跨不同贸易模式的分布、经济的加工贸易与一般贸易流量，以及经济福利。研究表明，加工贸易的存在会改变货币政策的权衡关系。当国内利率是唯一可用的政策工具时，在最终品出口生产中进口投入的产出弹性足够低（高）的情况下，次优最优利率将为零（正）。弗里德曼规则能否纠正贸易条件外部性带来的扭曲，取决于加工生产相对于一般生产具有较高的劳动密集度。
title: Global value chain participation and optimal monetary policy in a small open economy
title_zh: 全球价值链参与与小国开放经济中的最优货币政策

abstract: This paper develops a model of colonial wars and trade restrictions, in which two metropolises compete for control over a colony's trade policy. In equilibrium, the metropolis that gains control can improve its terms of trade by restricting its rival's access to colonial trade. However, implementing these restrictions often affects trade between the two metropolises themselves. Three equilibrium outcomes can arise: (i) peace with free trade, when both metropolises value trade with each other above colonial trade; (ii) war with exclusive colonial trade, when both prefer colonial trade to mutual trade; or (iii) war with either free or exclusive colonial trade, depending on whether the victor prioritizes trade with its rival over colonial trade. The model captures central features of the mercantilist era—rapid expansion of overseas commerce, colonial conflicts, and restrictive trade policies—and provides insights into the eventual decline of mercantilism.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于殖民战争与贸易限制的模型，其中两个宗主国争夺对殖民地贸易政策的控制权。在均衡状态下，获得控制权的宗主国可通过限制对手进入殖民地贸易来改善其贸易条件。然而，实施这些限制往往会影响两个宗主国之间的直接贸易。均衡结果可能出现三种情形：（i）和平与自由贸易，当双方均重视彼此间贸易超过殖民地贸易时；（ii）战争与殖民地贸易独占，当双方均偏好殖民地贸易而非相互贸易时；（iii）战争与自由贸易或殖民地贸易独占并存，取决于胜利者是将与对手的贸易置于殖民地贸易之上还是之下。该模型捕捉了重商主义时代的核心特征——海外商业的迅速扩张、殖民冲突及限制性贸易政策——并为其最终衰落提供了洞见。
title: Colonial wars and trade restrictions: Fighting for exclusive trading rights
title_zh: 殖民战争与贸易限制：争夺排他性贸易权

abstract: This paper meticulously investigates how the US‐China trade war of 2018–19 affected nondurable consumption patterns for households across the United States. Using highly granular NielsenIQ barcode scanner data, we find that a 1 percentage point (pp) increase in a county's tariff exposure growth was associated with a decrease in nondurable consumption growth ranging between 0.593 pp and 2.163 pp. Notably, this relationship existed for employed households but not for those without employment, and it was not confined to those working in manufacturing and farming. Additionally, households with children had lower consumption growth as tariff exposure increased, and the relationship was more negative for larger households. Regionally, Midwest households were more negatively affected than those in the New England, Pacific, and South Atlantic states. The relationship between household consumption growth and tariff exposure growth was similar for both more‐ and less‐durable goods. These findings have significant implications for understanding the economic and social impacts of trade wars on household consumption patterns.
abstract_zh: 本文细致考察了2018-19年中美贸易战如何影响美国各地家庭的非耐用品消费模式。利用高度细化的尼尔森IQ条形码扫描数据，我们发现，一个县关税暴露增长每增加1个百分点（pp），其非耐用品消费增长将下降0.593至2.163个百分点。值得注意的是，这一关系存在于就业家庭中，而非失业家庭，并且不仅限于制造业和农业从业者。此外，有子女的家庭在关税暴露增加时消费增长更低，且这一负向关系在规模较大的家庭中更为显著。从区域来看，中西部家庭受到的负面影响大于新英格兰、太平洋沿岸及南大西洋各州。家庭消费增长与关税暴露增长之间的关系在耐用品与非耐用品之间相似。这些发现对于理解贸易战对家庭消费模式的经济和社会影响具有重要意义。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: US‐China trade war: Heterogeneous effects on the US consumer
title_zh: 中美贸易战：对美国消费者的异质性影响

abstract: This paper evaluates the contribution of cross‐sector allocative efficiency to the productivity slowdown in the US during the 1970s and 2000s. We extend the framework of Oberfield (2013) to derive sufficient statistics for allocative efficiency and decompose aggregate productivity growth in a multisector economy. We find approximately two‐thirds of the productivity slowdown can be explained by the lack of improvement in allocative efficiency. Furthermore, data shows that increased sector‐level volatility is associated with the deterioration of allocative efficiency.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了20世纪70年代和2000年代美国跨部门配置效率对生产率放缓的贡献。我们扩展了Oberfield（2013）的框架，推导出配置效率的充分统计量，并在多部门经济中分解总体生产率增长。研究发现，约三分之二的生产率放缓可由配置效率缺乏改善来解释。此外，数据显示，部门层面波动性的增加与配置效率的恶化相关联。
title: Allocative efficiency and the productivity slowdown
title_zh: 配置效率与生产率放缓

abstract: Abstract How efficiently are workers, investment capital, and production distributed across firms in Canada? And how have they varied over time, across regions, and between sectors? To answer these questions, we present novel measures of the degree of resource misallocation over time and space using uniquely detailed firm‐level data (T2‐LEAP) between 2001 and 2015. We find the dispersion of marginal returns to both capital and labour across firms have increased significantly during this period, suggesting allocative efficiency is deteriorating. Using a rich but tractable multi‐sector model of heterogeneous firms, we find that had the misallocation of labour and capital not worsened over our period of analysis, aggregate Canadian productivity would be significantly higher. Worsening allocations between sectors alone accounts for approximately half of the widening productivity gap between Canada and the United States over this period.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在加拿大，工人、投资资本和生产在企业间的分配效率如何？这些效率随时间、地区和部门之间有何变化？为解答这些问题，我们利用2001年至2015年间独特详尽的企业层面数据（T2-LEAP），提出了衡量资源错配程度在时间和空间上的新指标。我们发现，在此期间，资本和劳动边际回报在企业间的离散度显著增加，表明配置效率正在恶化。通过一个丰富但易于处理的多部门异质性企业模型，我们发现，若在我们分析期间劳动和资本的错配未加剧，加拿大总体生产率将显著提高。仅部门间配置恶化一项，就大约解释了这一时期加拿大与美国之间生产率差距扩大的半数原因。
title: Aggregate productivity effect of labour and capital market distortions in Canada
title_zh: 加拿大劳动力与资本市场扭曲的总生产率效应

abstract: We document network effects in the diffusion of regulatory standards through international trade. Using both an instrumental variables approach, based on the time‐varying geographic component of trade, and a recentering approach, exploiting the timing of regulation adoption, we provide robust evidence that countries tend to domestically adopt the regulations of their key trade partners, especially when imposed by their export destinations. Leveraging the high dimensionality of our data, we show that the diffusion process is stronger for regulations and products with observable compliance. Our findings imply that economic integration can strengthen regulatory standards, aiding international policy coordination.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了监管标准通过国际贸易扩散的网络效应。利用基于贸易时间变化地理成分的工具变量方法，以及利用监管采纳时机的重新中心化方法，我们提供了有力证据表明，各国倾向于在国内采纳其主要贸易伙伴的监管规定，尤其是当其出口目的地实施这些规定时。借助我们数据的高维特性，我们展示了对于具有可观察合规性的法规和产品，扩散过程更为显著。我们的研究结果表明，经济一体化能够加强监管标准，有助于国际政策协调。
title: Economic integration and diffusion of regulatory standards: Evidence from trade networks
title_zh: 经济一体化与监管标准的扩散：来自贸易网络的证据

abstract: We examine how a student's field of degree and institution attended contribute to the labour market outcomes of young graduates. Administrative panel data that combines student transcripts with matched employer‐employee records allow us to provide the first decomposition of premia into individual‐ and firm‐specific components. We find that both major and institutional premia are more strongly related to the firm‐specific component of wages than the individual‐specific component of wages. On average, a student's major is a more important predictor of future wages than the selectivity of the institution attended, but major premia (and their relative ranking) can differ substantially across institutions, suggesting the importance of program‐level data for prospective students and their parents.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了学生的专业领域及所就读院校如何影响年轻毕业生的劳动力市场表现。通过结合学生成绩单与匹配的雇主-雇员记录的行政面板数据，我们首次将溢价分解为个人特定和公司特定组成部分。研究发现，无论是专业还是院校溢价，都与工资的公司特定组成部分关联更强，而非个人特定组成部分。平均而言，学生的专业对未来工资的预测力强于所就读院校的选拔性，但专业溢价（及其相对排名）在不同院校间可能存在显著差异，这表明对于潜在学生及其家长而言，项目层面的数据至关重要。
title: Institution, major and firm‐specific premia: Evidence from administrative data
title_zh: 制度、专业与企业特定溢价：基于行政数据的证据

abstract: We investigate whether different criteria are used in evaluating male and female leaders when outcomes are determined by unobservable choices and luck. Evaluators form beliefs about leaders’ choices (perceived intentions) and make discretionary payments. We find that while payments to male leaders are determined by both outcomes and perceived intentions, those to female leaders are determined by outcomes only. We label this new source of gender bias as the gender criteria gap . Our findings imply that high outcomes are necessary for women to get bonuses, but men can receive bonuses for low outcomes if evaluators hold them in high regard.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了当结果由不可观测的选择和运气决定时，评价男性与女性领导者是否采用不同标准。评价者会形成对领导者选择（感知意图）的信念，并据此进行酌情支付。研究发现，男性领导者的薪酬由结果和感知意图共同决定，而女性领导者的薪酬仅由结果决定。我们将这种新的性别偏见来源称为"性别标准差异"。研究结果表明，高绩效是女性获得奖金的必要条件，但若评价者对男性评价较高，即使其绩效较低，男性仍可获得奖金。
title: Gender Criteria Gap in Evaluation: Role of Perceived Intentions and Outcomes
title_zh: 评价中的性别标准差距：感知意图与结果的作用

abstract: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are the gold standard in causal inference. However, it is difficult for decision-makers to rely on RCTs when evaluating interventions that affect long-run outcomes. We elicit 25,980 forecasts from 505 participants to test the ability of people to predict the long-run outcomes of RCTs whose results were unknown to participants. Experienced forecasters, academic experts, and laypeople predict the outcomes of seven RCTs, each of which measured long-run outcomes at time horizons of at least five years. Experienced forecasters and academics were more accurate than laypeople, and experienced forecasters outperformed academics, at least in part due to their superior calibration. Aggregated forecasts outperform individual forecasts, showing a clear wisdom-of-the-crowd effect, but neither experienced forecasters nor academics consistently outperform simple benchmarks. We see no evidence of improved forecasting accuracy from randomly providing participants with additional information about good forecasting practices, details about the RCT interventions, or specifics about the local study context.
abstract_zh: 随机对照试验（RCTs）是因果推断的金标准。然而，在评估影响长期结果的干预措施时，决策者难以仅依赖RCTs。我们征集了505名参与者的25,980份预测，以检验人们预测RCTs长期结果的能力，而这些结果对参与者而言是未知的。经验丰富的预测者、学术专家及普通民众对七项RCTs的结果进行了预测，每项试验均测量了至少五年时间跨度的长期结果。结果显示，经验丰富的预测者和学术专家的预测准确性高于普通民众，且经验丰富的预测者优于学术专家，这部分归因于他们更优的校准能力。聚合预测优于个体预测，体现了明显的群体智慧效应，但无论是经验丰富的预测者还是学术专家，均未能持续超越简单基准模型。我们未发现随机向参与者提供关于良好预测实践、RCT干预细节或当地研究背景具体信息能显著提升预测准确性的证据。
title: Forecasting long-run causal effects
title_zh: 预测长期因果效应

abstract: With today’s shrinking budgets for development cooperation and criticism that International Development Cooperation Organizations (IDOs) often fail to use performance data to inform decision-making, it is essential to know if and how IDOs learn from their results-based management (RBM) practices. Learning is typically assumed to happen in a cyclical RBM learning loop. Learning is supposed to occur in the final stage of the loop when reporting should inform future decisions. We propose a new heuristic model for learning and observe that learning from results is, in fact, taking place in IDOs, but not in the way previously envisaged. Drawing on qualitative semi-structured interviews with 15 IDOs, we conclude that learning takes place at earlier stages of the RBM cycle, and that the strongest link to learning is in the first stage of planning and forecasting. Moreover, we observe that artifacts, interactive and dynamic dialogue, and drawing on various knowledge sources are key characteristics of learning from results practices. Beyond these, we consider Theories of Change as an artifact to be more likely to enable learning than other artifacts like reports as they visualize how problems will be turned into desirable futures and often mobilize staff in interactive processes. These findings should inform efforts to improve future RBM models to enable learning from results in IDOs by putting more effort into using results information in decision-making, streamlining RBM processes, and providing additional support for processes during the first stage of the RBM loop.
abstract_zh: 随着当今发展合作预算的缩减，以及国际发展合作组织（IDOs）常被批评未能利用绩效数据指导决策，了解IDOs是否以及如何从其基于结果的管理（RBM）实践中学习变得至关重要。学习通常被认为发生在循环的RBM学习回路中，预期在回路最后阶段，即报告应指导未来决策时发生。我们提出了一种新的学习启发式模型，并观察到IDOs中确实存在从结果中学习的情况，但并非以先前设想的方式进行。基于对15个IDOs的定性半结构化访谈，我们得出结论：学习发生在RBM周期的早期阶段，且与学习最强的联系在于规划和预测的第一阶段。此外，我们观察到，人工制品、互动和动态对话以及利用多种知识来源是从结果实践中学习的关键特征。除此之外，我们认为变革理论作为一种人工制品，相比报告等其他人工制品更可能促进学习，因为它们将问题如何转化为理想未来的过程可视化，并常在互动过程中动员员工。这些发现应有助于改进未来的RBM模型，通过更多努力利用结果信息进行决策、简化RBM流程，并在RBM循环的第一阶段提供额外支持，从而促进IDOs从结果中学习。
title: No need to wait for reporting − Examining learning from results-based management practices in development cooperation
title_zh: 无需等待报告——审视发展合作中基于结果的管理实践的学习

abstract: Why do poorer countries continue to adopt coal-fired power despite global climate pressures, while richer countries phase it out? This paper argues that the divergence in coal power phase-out trajectories between the Global North and South is driven by the coupling of greenfield investment with coal-fired power expansion in the Global South. Using matched global greenfield investments at the project level with coal plants at the city-level and employing the stacked DID strategy, we find that new coal-fired power installations increase cities’ inbound greenfield investment by 7.9% annually over eight years, particularly in low- and lower-middle-income countries; however, the inward capital is less oriented toward renewable technologies. This linkage arises from structural asymmetries: capital flows from the Global North to the South, the relocation of energy-intensive industries, and fragmented environmental regulation. Our findings highlight that the dilemma faced by developing countries: phasing out coal-fired power entails extremely high opportunity costs, while expanding coal power capacity crowds out investments in renewable technologies. Overall, we provide new evidence on how uneven development constraints result in fossil fuel dependency in the Global South.
abstract_zh: 为什么较贫穷的国家在全球气候压力下仍继续采用燃煤发电，而较富裕的国家却在逐步淘汰？本文认为，全球北方与南方之间煤电淘汰轨迹的分化，是由绿地投资与全球南方燃煤发电扩张的耦合所驱动。利用项目层面的全球绿地投资与城市层面的燃煤电厂相匹配的数据，并采用堆叠双重差分策略，我们发现新建燃煤电厂使城市年度外来绿地投资在八年内增加7.9%，尤其是在低收入和中等偏下收入国家；然而，这些流入资本对可再生技术的导向性较弱。这种关联源于结构性不对称：资本从全球北方流向南方、能源密集型产业的转移以及碎片化的环境监管。我们的研究结果凸显了发展中国家面临的困境：淘汰燃煤发电意味着极高的机会成本，而扩大煤电产能则会挤出对可再生技术的投资。总体而言，我们为不均衡发展约束如何导致全球南方对化石燃料的依赖提供了新的证据。
title: FDI and coal lock-in: The Global South’s development dilemma
title_zh: 外商直接投资与煤炭锁定：全球南方的发展困境

abstract: We formulate three sets of axioms to measure inequality of opportunity. First, the basic axioms that any relative measure should satisfy. Second, axioms that capture the ex ante perspective, focusing on inequality between individuals with different circumstances. Third, axioms that capture the ex post perspective, focusing on inequality among individuals with the same responsibility characteristics. Based on these axioms, we characterize the ex ante and ex post classes of inequality of opportunity measures. We also discuss how well existing measures in the literature adhere to the axioms.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了三组公理来度量机会不平等。第一组是任何相对度量方法均应满足的基本公理。第二组公理捕捉事前视角，聚焦于不同环境禀赋个体之间的不平等。第三组公理捕捉事后视角，聚焦于具有相同责任特征个体之间的不平等。基于这些公理，我们刻画了事前与事后两类机会不平等度量方法。同时，本文还探讨了现有文献中的度量方法对这些公理的遵循程度。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: An axiomatic approach to the measurement of inequality of opportunity
title_zh: 机会不平等测度的公理化方法

abstract: We study the intergenerational impact of birth-control policies on fertility and examine whether and how these policies reduce fertility, even after their abolition. We develop a model that integrates the endogenous evolution of fertility norms. Birth-control policies, through the reduction of mothers’ fertility, establish new norms that shape the fertility decisions of subsequent generations. Consequently, daughters’ fertility is lower due to these new norms, even when the policies are no longer in force. To test the model’s implications, we leverage a quasi-experimental setting provided by China’s One-Child Policy, which was implemented in a staggered manner starting in 1979 and gradually phased out beginning in 2014. Based on the recently released 2020 population census, our results reveal that the policy has an impact on reducing fertility and affects generations no longer subject to its regulations. This study is the first to provide causal evidence of birth-control policies from an intergenerational perspective and highlights the role of norms in shaping fertility outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文研究生育控制政策对生育率的代际影响，并探讨这些政策在废除后是否以及如何持续降低生育率。我们构建了一个融合生育规范内生演化的模型。生育控制政策通过降低母亲的生育率，建立了影响后代生育决策的新规范。因此，即使政策不再实施，女儿这一代的生育率也会因这些新规范而降低。为检验模型推论，我们利用中国独生子女政策提供的准实验环境——该政策自1979年起分阶段实施，并于2014年开始逐步退出。基于最新公布的2020年人口普查数据，研究结果表明，该政策不仅降低了生育率，还影响了不再受其约束的世代。本研究首次从代际视角为生育控制政策提供了因果证据，并揭示了规范在塑造生育结果中的关键作用。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: The Intergenerational Impact of Birth-Control Policies on Fertility: The Role of Norms
title_zh: 生育控制政策的代际影响：规范的作用

abstract: We study gender differences in the response to losing competitions using an online experiment (N=2,086). We find that both genders reduce tournament entry rates in response to losses that are unequivocally meritocratic. However, when the winner is not necessarily determined by merit—a setting perceived as less fair than the meritocratic tournament—female losers are relatively more discouraged. These results suggest that women are more negatively affected by competitions perceived as unfair than men. Exploratory machine learning analysis indicates that risk preferences, age and sports participation in adolescence are associated with a reduced impact of losing competitions.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项在线实验（N=2,086）研究性别在应对竞争失败时的差异。研究发现，在明确基于能力的竞争中，男女两性均会因失败而降低参赛率。然而，当获胜者并非必然由能力决定——这种情境被认为不如能力型竞争公平——女性失败者相对更受挫。这些结果表明，相较于男性，女性对被认为不公平的竞争会产生更消极的反应。探索性机器学习分析显示，风险偏好、年龄及青少年时期参与体育运动与竞争失败影响的减弱相关。
title: Does Unfairness Hurt Women? The Effects of Losing Unfair Competitions
title_zh: 不公平会伤害女性吗？输掉不公平竞争的影响

abstract: We propose a simple and general model of experimentation in which reaching untried levels of a stock variable may, after a stochastic delay, lead to a catastrophe. Hence, at any point in time a catastrophe might well be under way, due to past experiments. We show how to measure this legacy of the past from prior beliefs and the chronicle of stock levels. We characterize the optimal policy as a function of the legacy and show that it leads to a new protocol for planning that applies to a general class of problems, encompassing the study of pandemics or climate change. Several original policy predictions follow, e.g. experimentation can stop but resume later.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个简洁且通用的实验模型，在该模型中，当存量变量达到未经尝试的水平时，经过随机延迟后可能引发灾难。因此，在任何时间点，由于过去的实验，灾难可能已经在酝酿之中。我们展示了如何根据先验信念和存量水平的历史记录来衡量这种过去的遗留影响。我们将最优政策刻画为遗留影响的函数，并表明该政策导向一种适用于一般问题类别的新规划协议，涵盖流行病或气候变化研究。由此得出若干原创性政策预测，例如实验可能停止但随后重启。
title: Catastrophes, Delays, and Learning
title_zh: 灾难、延误与学习

abstract: Existing studies find that reducing income inequality increases greenhouse gas emissions. However, these analyses usually rely on household surveys that underrepresent top-income groups or on corrections that assume a constant relationship between income and emissions, both of which can distort the results. This study develops a new approach that combines tax microdata to correct the income distribution with machine-learning-based predictions of consumption to better estimate emissions among high-income households. Applied to Ecuador, a highly unequal country with institutional commitments to environmental protection, the approach identifies substantially higher emissions at the top of the income distribution and a non-monotonic pattern of emissions intensity per US$ of income that conventional methods fail to detect. Simulations show that full redistribution raises emissions by 26% under the new approach, compared with 6% in uncorrected surveys. These results underline the importance of better data and methods for evaluating inequality-emission trade-offs and designing redistribution policies.
abstract_zh: 现有研究发现，减少收入不平等会增加温室气体排放。然而，这些分析通常依赖于对高收入群体代表性不足的家庭调查，或依赖于假设收入与排放之间关系恒定的修正方法，这两者都可能扭曲结果。本研究开发了一种新方法，结合税收微观数据以修正收入分布，并利用基于机器学习的消费预测，更准确地估算高收入家庭的排放量。将该方法应用于厄瓜多尔——一个高度不平等且对环境保护有制度承诺的国家——研究发现，收入分布顶端的排放量显著更高，且每美元收入的排放强度呈现非单调模式，而传统方法未能检测到这一现象。模拟显示，在新方法下，完全再分配使排放增加26%，而在未修正的调查中仅为6%。这些结果强调了更优的数据和方法对于评估不平等与排放之间的权衡以及设计再分配政策的重要性。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 139
title: Amplified challenges for the joint reduction of emissions and inequality, considering the missing-rich
title_zh: 考虑缺失富裕人群时，排放与不平等协同减排的加剧挑战

abstract: How does oil shape anti-state dissent? While previous research suggests that oil wealthy countries may be less likely to democratize and more likely to experience civil wars, few studies have examined how oil wealth shapes the broader composition of anti-state resistance, from political parties, to trade unions, and CSOs. We argue that high levels of oil wealth lower the probability that economically based organizations (such as trade unions) and civil society organizations participate in anti-state dissent by eroding the supply of these organizations and enabling selective cooptation and repression. However, we also argue that oil wealth does not impact political parties, armed rebel groups, and what we label “protest organizations” in the same way, leading to dissent that is more concentrated around organizations designed to capture state power. Using data on the organizational composition of resistance campaigns in Africa from 1990-2015, our findings suggest that high levels of oil wealth reduce the probability of observing economic organizations and CSOs among dissenting organizations and the probability that organizations in general mobilize from economic sectors. Mechanism tests suggest that oil limits the participation of economic organizations in dissent by shrinking or impeding the development of a strong manufacturing sector.
abstract_zh: 石油如何影响反政府抗议？尽管先前的研究表明，石油资源丰富的国家可能更不易民主化，且更易发生内战，但很少有研究探讨石油财富如何塑造反政府抵抗的更广泛构成，包括政党、工会和公民社会组织。我们认为，高水平的石油财富通过削弱这些组织的供给并促成选择性合作与镇压，降低了经济型组织（如工会）和公民社会组织参与反政府抗议的可能性。然而，我们也认为，石油财富对政党、武装反叛团体以及我们称之为“抗议组织”的影响方式不同，导致抗议活动更集中于旨在夺取国家权力的组织。利用1990年至2015年间非洲抵抗运动组织构成的数据，我们的研究结果表明，高水平的石油财富降低了经济组织和公民社会组织出现在抗议组织中的概率，也降低了组织普遍从经济部门动员的可能性。机制测试表明，石油通过缩减或阻碍强大制造业部门的发展，限制了经济组织参与抗议活动。
title: The mobilization curse? How oil wealth affects the composition of resistance episodes
title_zh: 动员的诅咒？石油财富如何影响抵抗事件的构成

abstract: International migration affects labor supply, production patterns, and external income flows in origin countries, yet our understanding of its economy-wide and distributional consequences remains limited, particularly with regard to the role of return migration. This study integrates detailed microdata on migrant profiles into a general equilibrium model applied to Guatemala to examine how emigration and return migration affect macroeconomic performance, sectoral dynamics, and household welfare. We simulate three scenarios: a reference scenario reflecting recent-historical emigration patterns (MIG-0), a reduced-emigration scenario (MIG-1), and a net-return migration scenario (MIG-2), capturing recent shifts in emigration and return flows by skill level. Results reveal trade-offs between aggregate economic performance and distributional impacts across households. Compared to a baseline economy with no mobility, Gross Domestic Product (GDP) rises modestly under the reference scenario (+0.2 percent) and by additional 0.3–0.5 percentage points under the reduced-emigration and net-return scenarios, driven by expanded labor supply from returnees and currency depreciation. Non-agro-processing manufacturing shows the largest expansion (up to 1.8 percent), reflecting its strong labor-absorption potential. Household welfare, especially among remittance-dependent households, is highly sensitive to these flows, with income and consumption declining under the two counterfactual migration scenarios. These findings underscore the need for policies that facilitate returnee reintegration and strengthen social protection for remittance-dependent households, ensuring that the macroeconomic gains from migration adjustments translate into equitable welfare improvements.
abstract_zh: 国际移民影响来源国的劳动力供给、生产模式和外部收入流动，然而我们对其整体经济及分配后果的理解仍然有限，尤其是关于回流移民的作用。本研究将关于移民特征的详细微观数据整合到应用于危地马拉的一般均衡模型中，以考察移民出境和回流移民如何影响宏观经济表现、部门动态和家庭福利。我们模拟了三种情景：反映近期历史移民模式的参考情景（MIG-0）、移民减少情景（MIG-1）和净回流移民情景（MIG-2），捕捉了近期按技能水平划分的移民出境和回流流动的变化。结果揭示了总体经济表现与家庭间分配影响之间的权衡。与无流动性的基准经济相比，参考情景下国内生产总值（GDP）温和上升（+0.2%），在移民减少和净回流情景下进一步上升0.3–0.5个百分点，这得益于回流者带来的劳动力供给扩大和货币贬值。非农产品加工业扩张幅度最大（最高达1.8%），反映了其强大的劳动力吸收潜力。家庭福利，尤其是依赖汇款的家庭，对这些流动高度敏感，在两种反事实移民情景下，其收入和消费均出现下降。这些发现强调了制定促进回流者重新融入社会并加强对依赖汇款家庭社会保护政策的必要性，以确保移民调整带来的宏观经济收益转化为公平的福利改善。
title: The two sides of migration in Central America: aggregate and distributional impacts in Guatemala
title_zh: 中美洲移民的两面性：危地马拉的总体与分配影响

abstract: This study investigates how in-game virtual currencies influence consumer spending behaviour. In an incentivized randomized controlled trial with 753 UK participants, we estimate the willingness-to-pay (WTP) for loot boxes represented as risky and ambiguous lotteries. We test the effects of virtual currencies, money illusion, and cognitive-demanding (non-intuitive) exchange rates, three practices commonly used to sell loot boxes. Our results show that WTP is significantly higher when transactions are conducted in virtual currencies with a 1:1 exchange rate compared to British pounds, contributing to the debate on the neutrality of virtual currencies and experimental currency units. Moreover, participants in our study are affected by money illusion distortions, regardless of the exchange rate’s intuitiveness. However, we find no evidence that non-intuitive exchange rates affect participants’ WTP compared to intuitive exchange rates of comparable size. These findings highlight the behavioural distortions induced by common monetization practices in games and provide empirical support for the European Commission’s call for stricter regulation of virtual currencies in digital environments.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了游戏内虚拟货币如何影响消费者支出行为。通过一项包含753名英国参与者的激励性随机对照试验，我们估算了以风险性和模糊性彩票形式呈现的“战利品箱”的支付意愿（WTP）。我们检验了虚拟货币、货币幻觉以及认知负荷（非直观）汇率这三种常用于销售战利品箱的实践效应。结果显示，当交易以1:1汇率的虚拟货币进行时，支付意愿显著高于以英镑计价的情况，这为虚拟货币与实验货币单位的中立性争论提供了新证据。此外，无论汇率是否直观，参与者均受到货币幻觉扭曲的影响。然而，与规模相近的直观汇率相比，我们未发现非直观汇率对参与者支付意愿产生影响的证据。这些发现揭示了游戏中常见货币化实践所引发的行为扭曲，并为欧盟委员会呼吁在数字环境中加强虚拟货币监管提供了实证支持。
title: Virtual currencies in online gaming increase the willingness to pay for loot boxes: an experimental analysis
title_zh: 网络游戏中的虚拟货币提升对开箱付费意愿：一项实验分析

abstract: This paper applies distributional deep reinforcement learning to solve dynamic quantile models with uncertainty. We focus on agents who evaluate outcomes based on specific quantiles of the utility distribution, capturing intratemporal risk attitudes via a quantile level τ ∈ (0, 1). We formulate a recursive quantile value function associated with time-consistent dynamic quantile preferences in a Markov decision process, where at each period the agent maximizes the quantile of a distribution composed of instantaneous utility combined with the discounted future value, conditioned on the current state. We adapt the Actor-Critic framework to learn the τ-quantile of the distribution and the policy maximizing the τ-quantile. We demonstrate the accuracy and robustness of the proposed algorithm using an intertemporal consumption model with known analytical solutions, benchmarking against value function iteration. The results show that the algorithm provides accurate approximations of theoretical value and policy functions. Compared to value function iteration, the neural network approximation produces smoother estimates and avoids discretization errors inherent in grid-based methods. As model dimensionality increases, the algorithm scales well to higher dimensions and provides faster solutions with smaller computational requirements compared to value function iteration. The algorithm is robust to various network architectures and weight initializations.
abstract_zh: 本文运用分布深度强化学习求解具有不确定性的动态分位数模型。我们关注基于效用分布特定分位数评估结果的决策者，通过分位数水平τ∈(0,1)捕捉期内风险态度。我们在马尔可夫决策过程中构建了与时间一致动态分位数偏好相关的递归分位数价值函数，其中在每个时期，决策者最大化由瞬时效用与折现未来价值组合而成的分布的分位数，该分布以当前状态为条件。我们调整Actor-Critic框架以学习分布的τ分位数及最大化τ分位数的策略。我们利用具有已知解析解的跨期消费模型，通过与价值函数迭代进行基准比较，验证了所提算法的准确性和稳健性。结果表明，该算法能精确逼近理论价值函数和策略函数。与价值函数迭代相比，神经网络逼近方法产生更平滑的估计，并避免了基于网格方法固有的离散化误差。随着模型维度的增加，该算法能良好扩展至更高维度，并在计算需求更小的情况下提供更快的求解，优于价值函数迭代。该算法对多种网络架构和权重初始化具有稳健性。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 190
title: Gradient-based reinforcement learning for dynamic quantile models
title_zh: 基于梯度的动态分位数模型强化学习

abstract: This paper examines how the fragmentation of production across Global Value Chains (GVCs) generates both economic and environmental inequalities. Integrating OECD ICIO and CO2 emission data, our analysis reveals an environmental smile curve, where environmental and economic downgrading co-occur in middle segments of GVCs, reinforcing global inequalities. These disparities intensify with deeper GVC penetration, challenging the decoupling narrative of green growth. By integrating labour and emission data, we provide novel evidence of how GVCs structurally embed asymmetric power relations between production segments, generating unequal ecological and economic burdens across the globe. While the Global North has strategically benefited from GVCs, the Global South has experienced the heightening of its peripheral and subordinated position.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了全球价值链（GVCs）中生产碎片化如何同时引发经济与环境不平等。通过整合OECD ICIO和CO2排放数据，我们的分析揭示了一条环境微笑曲线，其中环境与经济降级在全球价值链中间环节同时发生，加剧了全球不平等。这些差异随着全球价值链渗透的加深而加剧，对绿色增长的去耦叙事构成挑战。通过整合劳动力和排放数据，我们提供了新的证据，表明全球价值链如何在生产环节之间结构性嵌入不对称的权力关系，从而在全球范围内产生不平等的生态与经济负担。尽管全球北方战略性地从全球价值链中获益，全球南方则经历了其边缘化和从属地位的加剧。
title: The environmental smile curve: input-output evidence on the pollution haven hypothesis
title_zh: 环境微笑曲线：污染避难所假说的投入产出证据

abstract: Considerable evidence suggests that people are internally motivated to keep their promises. But it is unclear whether such internal motivations create a meaningful level of commitment in economically relevant situations where promisors have strong self-interested reasons to break their promises. Self-interested incentives to break promises compete with—and so may overcome—the moral motivations of those who are internally motivated to keep them. We experimentally investigate the willingness of third parties to altruistically punish promise breaking. Participants observe a transaction between a potential promisor and promisee and can incur personal costs to punish the promisor for uncooperative actions. Our results suggest that the same moral reasons that motivate promisors to keep their promises make third-party observers more likely to punish promise breaking. This suggests that the same underlying promissory norms drive both (i) promise-keeping behavior in the absence of second- and third-party enforcement mechanisms and (ii) non-legal enforcement mechanisms that arise when third parties can punish potential promisors in a decentralized fashion. This makes it more likely that promissory norms support cooperative behavior
abstract_zh: 大量证据表明，人们内心有遵守承诺的动机。但在承诺方有强烈自利动机违背承诺的经济相关情境中，这种内在动机能否形成有意义的承诺约束尚不明确。违背承诺的自利激励与内在道德动机相互竞争——甚至可能压倒后者。我们通过实验研究第三方利他性惩罚违背承诺行为的意愿。参与者观察潜在承诺方与受诺方之间的交易，并可通过承担个人成本来惩罚承诺方的不合作行为。研究结果表明，促使承诺方信守承诺的道德理由同样会使第三方观察者更倾向于惩罚违背承诺行为。这意味着相同的承诺规范同时驱动着：（i）在缺乏第二方与第三方执行机制时的信守承诺行为；（ii）当第三方能够以分散化方式惩罚潜在承诺方时产生的非法律执行机制。这使得承诺规范更有可能支持合作行为。
title: Norm-based enforcement of promises
title_zh: 基于规范的承诺执行
